title: Interesting Roman ruins
text: Well worth the drive from Algeciras or Tarifa.  Good signage available in Spanish and English. They are still excavating the site, so be on the look out for archaeologists.  We walked around for about an hour. There are 2 restaurants right next to the site.  Space is spread out so no issues with crowds.  If you're interested in Archaeology, ruins, or Roman history, highly recommend coming here for a visit.
author: shellyg173

title: Transport to the past
text:
I just wonder what it should be like to live in Baelo Claudia. A beach as amazing as Bologna, with the remains of a Roman city.
Archaeological excavations continue to be carried out to continue discovering the wonders that are buried.
The theater left me speechless, to this day, performances and concerts continue to be made. A unique setting, with the sea a few hundred meters away.
I just hope the fires and wild urbanism don't destroy the magic around her.
author: VictorFlashman

title: A reference archaeological park for archeological connoisseurs.
text: An archaeological park visited many years ago, which for the beauty of the site and position overlooking the beach of Bolonia, represents an example for care and integration of nature and greenery, very well designed.
author: Giannandrea G

title: What an amazing site
text: For those with an interest in Roman archeological sites this is one of the best - and gratis ! We were given a warm welcome and written information of a high standard ( and in English ). A museum inside then a fascinating site and in a very picturesque location. A big site to explore and with a teatro. I would definitely rate this highly; very impressive indeed .
author: Redhead146

title: Roman village
text: Fantastic Roman village right next to the sea. Well preserved I'm taking care of. Excellent day out for the family especially those who love history. Well worth the visit
author: Oratava P

title: Culture and history at the beach
text: Beautiful Roman ruins on the coast, near Bolonia. Good to combine with the beach of Bolonia. Note: not pleasant in too much wind. Excavation is nicely situated, free visit. Old fish processing site of tuna.
author: Bas v
